# v0.4.2 — A cleaner topic workspace, settings inside DSH's Settings

## What's changed

- **The topic workspace is redesigned.** A filter at the top shows everything, the topics **Waiting on you**, or the **Done** ones, and a search box finds a topic by its title, summary or progress. In each workspace, topics waiting on you come first and finished ones last. The header keeps one main button, **New topic**; occasional actions (organizing history, choosing chats, clearing learned links) wait behind the **⋯** beside it. **Recent topic routing** moved below the topics, and **Feedback**, the user group, email and GitHub sit quietly at the bottom of the page. An empty workspace says what will appear there and offers the way back to main chat.
- **Sorting earlier chats, said plainly.** The first-run card is now **Pick up your earlier chats**, with **Organize N chats**, **Choose chats** and **Skip for now**.
- **TheOne's settings moved into DSH's own Settings.** They appear as a **TheOne** page in DSH's Settings dialog and match DSH's own pages: on/off settings are switches, and limits and storage are folded under **Advanced**. Right-clicking the TheOne button and choosing **Settings** opens that page directly.
- **Experimental features are off by default.** **Share confirmed facts**, **Record facts automatically** and **Ongoing tasks** sit in an **Experimental** section at the bottom of the settings. While **Ongoing tasks** is off, the sidebar has no **Ongoing tasks** entry and topics cannot create one; tasks you already had wait quietly and carry on when it is turned back on.
- **A new welcome.** Main chat opens with a short welcome that says this is a beta. The getting-started card under it keeps its main action and adds icons for the user group, email and GitHub, each described on hover; clicking email copies the address as well as opening your mail app.
- **Shorter copy throughout the settings**, written as product text, in Chinese and English.

Validation: type checks and the full automated suite (418 tests, including Ongoing tasks staying off by default and resuming when turned back on, the new settings field, and the new welcome) pass on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, and the plugin archive builds.

## 中文

- **话题工作区重做**：页面上方可以按「全部」「等你处理」「已完成」筛选，搜索框能按标题、摘要和进展找话题。每个工作区里，等你处理的排在最前，已完成的排在最后。右上角只留一个主按钮「新话题」，整理历史、选择会话、清空学到的关联这些不常用的操作收进旁边的「⋯」。「最近的话题分配」挪到话题下面；「反馈」、用户群、邮箱和 GitHub 放在页面最底部。工作区还空着时，会说明这里会出现什么，并提供「回主聊天」。
- **整理以前的聊天，说得更直接**：第一次打开时的卡片改为「接上以前的聊天」，按钮是「整理 N 个会话」「选择会话」「暂时跳过」。
- **TheOne 设置搬进 DSH 自己的设置**：在 DSH 设置弹窗左侧多了「TheOne」一页，样式和 DSH 原生设置一致：开关类设置改成开关，内容限制和数据位置收进折叠的「高级」。右键左侧的 TheOne 按钮选「设置」，会直接打开这一页。
- **测试功能默认关闭**：「共享已确认的要点」「自动记录要点」「持续任务」放在设置最下面的「测试功能」里。「持续任务」关闭时，侧边栏没有「持续任务」入口，话题也不会新建任务；已有的任务暂停，重新打开后接着检查。
- **新的欢迎语**：主聊天的第一条消息改为简短的欢迎，并说明目前是测试版。下面的入门卡片保留主要操作，加上用户群、邮箱、GitHub 三个图标，鼠标移上去显示说明；点邮箱会复制地址，同时打开邮件程序。
- **设置里的文案更短**，统一成产品化的表述，中英文都已更新。

验证：在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 上类型检查和全部自动化测试（418 项，含「持续任务」默认关闭、重新打开后继续检查、新的设置项和新的欢迎语）通过，插件包构建正常。
